Trigger.Name: WHEN-BUTTON-PRESSED
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 lv_ProcCode VARCHAR2(200);
 lv_mapName VARCHAR2(200);
BEGIN

 -- Mapping validation.
 If :CTRL_BLK_1.MAPPING_NAME IS NULL Then
 show_error('0080', ' - Mapping Name');
 check_package_failure;
 End If;
 -- 
 
 If :CTRL_BLK_1.DATA_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL AND :CTRL_BLK_1.DATA_COLUMN_NAME IS NULL THEN
 show_error('24008');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSIF :CTRL_BLK_1.DATA_TABLE_NAME IS NULL AND :CTRL_BLK_1.DATA_COLUMN_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN
 show_error('24008');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 
 IF globalvar.g_AddRec THEN 

 INSERT INTO EMF_PROCESS_MAPPING
 (process_code, mapping_name, data_table_name,
 data_column_name, where_clause, sql_stmt,
 program_id, insert_date, insert_user, audit_key)
 VALUES
 (:CTRL_BLK.PROCESS_CODE, :ctrl_blk_1.mapping_name, :ctrl_blk_1.data_table_name,
 :ctrl_blk_1.data_column_name, :ctrl_blk_1.where_clause, :ctrl_blk_1.sql_stmt,
 :BANNER.PROG_NAME, SYSDATE, :BANNER.DISPLAY_USER_ID, NULL);

 ELSE
 If :CTRL_BLK_1.MAPPING_NAME <> :PROC_MAP.MAPPING_NAME 
 Or NVL(:CTRL_BLK_1.DATA_TABLE_NAME,'@') <> NVL(:PROC_MAP.DATA_TABLE_NAME,'@')
 Or NVL(:CTRL_BLK_1.DATA_COLUMN_NAME,'@')<> NVL(:PROC_MAP.DATA_COLUMN_NAME,'@')
 Or NVL(:CTRL_BLK_1.WHERE_CLAUSE,'@') <> NVL(:PROC_MAP.WHERE_CLAUSE,'@')
 Or NVL(:CTRL_BLK_1.SQL_STMT,'@') <> NVL(:PROC_MAP.SQL_STMT,'@') Then

 UPDATE emf_process_mapping
 SET mapping_name = :CTRL_BLK_1.MAPPING_NAME, 
 data_table_name = :CTRL_BLK_1.DATA_TABLE_NAME,
 data_column_name = :CTRL_BLK_1.DATA_COLUMN_NAME,
 where_clause = :CTRL_BLK_1.WHERE_CLAUSE,
 sql_stmt = :CTRL_BLK_1.SQL_STMT
 WHERE process_code = :PROC_MAP.PROCESS_CODE
 AND mapping_name = :PROC_MAP.MAPPING_NAME;
 End If;

 END IF;

 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '10';
 COMMIT;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 
 if form_success then
 show_error('9163');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 lv_procCode := :CTRL_BLK.PROCESS_CODE;
 lv_mapName := :CTRL_BLK.MAP_NAME;
 
 CLEAR_FORM(NO_VALIDATE);
 initialise_windows;
 
 :CTRL_BLK.PROCESS_CODE := lv_procCode;
 :CTRL_BLK.MAP_NAME := lv_mapName;
 QUERY_PROC_MAP;
 
 --item_change('CTRL_BLK.PB_NEW_MAPPING', 'E');
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Causing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) = 'CHANGED' ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Cursor_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PACKAGE BODY PARM_VALIDATIONS IS

 PROCEDURE parm_type IS

 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;

 PROCEDURE ref_table IS 
 PROCEDURE validate_tbl(p_tblName IN VARCHAR2) IS 
 CURSOR tab_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM all_tables
 WHERE table_name = p_tblName
 AND owner IN ('SBCSYS', 'DONSYS', 'UTIL', 'SRVSYS', 'LTAPI', 'LTWEB', 'VISTA');
 n_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 b_recFound BOOLEAN;
 BEGIN
 OPEN tab_cur;
 FETCH tab_cur INTO n_dummy;
 b_recFound := tab_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE tab_cur;
 
 If NOT b_recFound Then
 show_error('24004');
 check_package_failure; 
 End If;
 END validate_tbl; 
 PROCEDURE validate_fcn(p_fcn_name IN VARCHAR2) IS
 nCnt NUMBER;
 BEGIN
 select count(1) into nCnt
 from fcn
 where fcn_type = 'FRM'
 and exec_name = p_fcn_name; --:emf_target_process.action_fncs;
 
 IF nCnt = 0 THEN
 show_error('24014');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END validate_fcn;
 BEGIN
 IF :EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_TABLE IS NULL THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('0080', ' - Table Name.');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF INSTR(:EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_TABLE ,',') = 0 THEN
 VALIDATE_TBL(:EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_TABLE);
 ELSE
 FOR rec IN (SELECT regexp_substr(:EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_TABLE,'[^,]+', 1, level) tbl_name from dual
 connect by regexp_substr(:EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_TABLE, '[^,]+', 1, level) is not null)
 LOOP
 VALIDATE_TBL(TRIM(rec.tbl_name));
 END LOOP; 
 END IF;

 
 END ref_table;

 PROCEDURE ref_column IS
 CURSOR col_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM all_tab_cols
 WHERE table_name IN (SELECT TRIM(regexp_substr(:EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_TABLE,'[^,]+', 1, level)) tbl_name from dual
 connect by regexp_substr(:EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_TABLE, '[^,]+', 1, level) is not null)
 AND column_name LIKE :EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_COLUMN ||'%';
 
 n_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 b_recFound BOOLEAN;
 BEGIN
 
 IF :EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_TABLE IS NULL THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('24006');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 IF :EMF_PARM_DEF.REF_COLUMN IS NULL THEN
 SHOW_ERROR('0080', ' - Ref. Column.');
 CHECK_PACKAGE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 
 OPEN col_cur;
 FETCH col_cur INTO n_dummy;
 b_recFound := col_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE col_cur;
 
 If NOT b_recFound Then
 show_error('24005');
 check_package_failure; 
 End If; 
 END ref_column; 
END;
